## Overview

This 2026-09-16 captured [[braintree]] developer page occupies a Node request-reference route titled Apple Pay: Unregister Domain. Its body contains only an availability notice: at capture time, it said only the PHP and Ruby SDKs supported managing Apple Pay web domains through the Braintree API. The page does not document a Node request object, request method, route body or parameters, response/result, or code example. Treat it as route-and-availability evidence, not as an operational Node unregister-domain procedure. See [[braintree-apple-pay]].

## Key takeaways

- The page title and slug identify the intended action as unregistering an Apple Pay domain on a Node-scoped request-reference route. They do not establish that a Node SDK operation exists or succeeds.
- The substantive body qualifies API-based Apple Pay web-domain management as currently supported only by the PHP and Ruby SDKs. Because this is a dated snapshot statement, it does not prove current SDK support, merchant eligibility, domain state, configuration, or successful unregistration.
